system.description:
Will Amp

When you enter your Crash state, by spending 1 Pyroclasm, you begin to Overheat for the duration of the Crash state.

While overheating, Ninjutsu you cast with the Fire Release keyword gain a +4 bonus to the damage it deals.

While overheating, you take 1d6 fire damage at the end of each of your turns. This damage cannot be reduced or resisted by any means.
system.summary: Crash, plus +4 damage on Fire Release Ninjutsu; take 1d6 fire at the end of each of your turns.

rules.text: +4 Fire Release Ninjutsu damage and 1d6 fire damage to you at the end of each of your turns, unreduced (both on this effect).
rules.label: Chakra Surge: Crash (Overheat)

rules.text: Once per casting, Ninjutsu you cast deal +3d10 damage (half the dice for an area). This is added automatically when you cast.
You can use two or more Moldings on one casting; you can use the Draw Reserves skill action as an Action.
